Messages.Author: Stolas
Messages.Body:
Dear Methuselahs!

I was informed VEKN had a forum and that people use this to find events. I was under the impression people check the Event Calendar monthly.
Anyway it is my pleasure to announce the Dutch Nationals!

At the end of this month on the 24th of November in the huge city of Wijchen.
In the announcement there are a few mistakes, which we can't seem to change.
www.vekn.net/event-calendar/event/11560

The event is 3+F NOT 4+F.
And decklists will be collection (optional) because we really want to be recorded in the
VTES Tournaments decks archive extended.
If you deliver the decklist _prior_ to the event in either paper or digital form a little extra will be added to your welcome package. Decklists wont be looked at till after the event (for obvious reasons).

Looking forward to see even more registrations.
